items.definition:
a thin sphere of liquid enclosing air or another gas
Children love to blow soap bubbles.

person who buys
The buyer was happy with the purchase.

polite man
He behaved like a true gentleman.

long-distance race
She trained for months to run the marathon.

public procession
We watched the Thanksgiving Day parade.

the act of allowing to enter
Admission to the museum is free on Tuesdays.

cows, bulls, or oxen, kept for meat or milk
The farmer moved his cattle to a new pasture.

a cultivated plant that is grown on a large scale commercially
The main crop grown here is corn.

a sudden violent shaking of the ground
The earthquake caused widespread damage to the city.

a place on the coast where ships may find shelter
The ships were docked safely in the harbor.

the science of numbers, quantities, and shapes
She is studying advanced mathematics at university.

medicine
The doctor prescribed new medication for her cough.

digital audio program
I listen to a lot of podcasts during my commute.

financial aid for students
She received a scholarship to study at university.

a chronological sequence of events
The project timeline shows all the key dates.

a place for making things; a training session
We attended a workshop on digital marketing.

a distinctive way of pronouncing a language
She has a strong French accent.

a ray of light; a long, sturdy piece of timber
A beam of sunlight shone through the window.

a large wild ox
We saw a herd of buffalo in the national park.

a bending line
The car slowed down as it approached the sharp curve in the road.

a hard, pointed growth on an animal's head; a device for making a loud sound
The car driver honked the horn.

a component part of a mixture
Flour is a key ingredient in bread.

an educational talk to an audience
The professor gave an interesting lecture on history.

the direction between north and west
The wind is blowing from the northwest.

a part of an animal or plant body with a specific function; a large musical instrument
The heart is a vital organ.

a hard, glistening object produced within the soft tissue of a living shelled mollusk
She wore a necklace with a beautiful pearl.

pile
There was a pile of books on the table.

plug
He pulled the plug out of the wall.

sweat
After running, he was covered in sweat.

cabin
We stayed in a small cabin by the lake.

cheer
The crowd let out a loud cheer.

disc
The CD is a small, round disc.

profession
Teaching is a noble profession.

a doctor who performs operations
The surgeon explained the procedure carefully.

an official endorsement on a passport allowing entry into a country
You need a visa to enter that country.

recognition and enjoyment of the good qualities of something
We showed our appreciation for their hard work.

a long strip of cloth bearing a slogan or design
The protest marchers carried a large banner.

the power or quality of delighting or attracting
Her charm made everyone feel at ease.

the latest time or date by which something should be completed
The deadline for the project is Friday.

a dense forest in tropical regions
The explorers ventured deep into the Amazon jungle.

professor (an abbreviation)
Prof. Smith gave an interesting lecture today.

a type of popular music of US black origin in which words are recited rapidly and rhythmically over a prerecorded backing
He enjoys listening to rap music.

a brief account of one's professional or work experience and qualifications, often submitted with a job application
Please attach your resume to the application form.

a group of people, often of related families, who live together, sharing the same language, culture, and history
The indigenous tribe has lived in this region for centuries.

illustrations, photographs, or other graphic material prepared for inclusion in a book, magazine, or other publication
The museum features modern artwork from local artists.

the action or power of evoking interest, pleasure, or liking in someone or something
The Eiffel Tower is a major tourist attraction in Paris.

a person or organization competing with others for the same objective or for superiority in the same field of activity
Our main competitor just released a similar product.

a firm hold or grasp
He lost his grip on the rope and fell.

a small number or amount; a person or thing that is difficult to control
Only a handful of students passed the difficult exam.

a person who makes pottery
The potter shaped the clay into a beautiful vase.

a greater liking for one alternative over another
Do you have a preference for tea or coffee?

a ceremonial chair for a sovereign, bishop, or other high dignitary
The king sat on his golden throne.

a woman thought to have magic powers, especially evil ones
The old witch lived in a house made of gingerbread.

a mechanical failure or a collapse of mental health
The car had a breakdown on the highway.

something given to a charity, especially a sum of money
We made a donation to the local animal shelter.

a small part used to join or connect other parts
The plumber replaced the faulty pipe fitting.

a storm with a violent wind, in particular a tropical cyclone in the Caribbean
The hurricane caused widespread damage along the coast.

a commodity, article, or service brought in from abroad for sale
The country relies heavily on oil imports.

an organ for breathing
The doctor examined his lungs.

the process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth
Good nutrition is essential for a healthy lifestyle.

an evergreen coniferous tree
The forest was filled with tall pine trees.

something that is rented, or the act of renting
We picked up our car rental at the airport.

the direction or region between south and west
They traveled to the southwest of the country.

a person who remains alive after an event that could have killed them
She was the sole survivor of the accident.
